verdict.rationale: A business-formalities filing portal could plausibly offer scheduled or unattended filings, or an automation API for high-volume mandataires, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only describes interactive web filing, dashboards, progress tracking and payment modalities. The open keyless API in the probe belongs to a separate state company-data service, not the Guichet unique itself, so it earns no credit here. No background automation, scheduling or autonomous execution capability is documented.
